raw.query: WITH current_eda AS (SELECT run_id, window_name, window_span_s, window_requests FROM provenance.v_dim WHERE is_current = true AND superseded_by IS NULL AND run_id LIKE 'eda:%'), quality AS (SELECT e.metric_path, e.value_num, e.value_text FROM current_eda d JOIN provenance.eda_metric e ON e.run_id = d.run_id WHERE d.run_id = 'eda:a_quality' AND e.metric_path IN ('rows','t_start','t_end','duration_hours')), pivoted AS (SELECT max(value_num) FILTER (WHERE metric_path = 'rows') AS requests, max(value_text) FILTER (WHERE metric_path = 't_start') AS t_start, max(value_text) FILTER (WHERE metric_path = 't_end') AS t_end, max(value_num) FILTER (WHERE metric_path = 'duration_hours') AS duration_hours FROM quality), windows AS (SELECT count(*) AS current_run_count, count(DISTINCT window_name) AS distinct_windows, min(window_span_s) AS min_window_span_s, max(window_span_s) AS max_window_span_s, min(window_requests) AS min_window_requests, max(window_requests) AS max_window_requests FROM current_eda) SELECT p.requests, p.t_start, p.t_end, extract(epoch FROM (p.t_end::timestamp - p.t_start::timestamp)) AS measured_span_seconds, p.duration_hours, w.current_run_count, w.distinct_windows, w.min_window_span_s, w.max_window_span_s, w.min_window_requests, w.max_window_requests FROM pivoted p CROSS JOIN windows w
